rust.name: crates/sqlite/src/work.rs:222:55: replace > with >= in claim
rust.why: This delays a claim exactly at the pace deadline, which tests that advance time past the deadline would miss.

rust.name: crates/sqlite/src/work.rs:261:5: replace named -> Result<Vec<Work>> with Ok(vec![])
rust.why: Claiming and fetching work by ID bypass this lookup, so detecting it requires listing a name with stored work.

rust.name: crates/sqlite/src/tables.rs:23:5: replace has -> Result<bool> with Ok(true)
rust.why: Operations on declared tables still work, so detecting this requires exercising a missing table.

rust.name: crates/sqlite/src/lib.rs:367:9: replace <impl Store for SqliteStore>::row -> Result<Option<Value>> with Ok(None)
rust.why: Projection writes and list queries bypass this entry point, so detecting it requires fetching an existing row by key through the store.

rust.name: crates/sqlite/src/work.rs:203:49: delete ! in claim
rust.why: This reverses the name filter and leaves claims with no name filter unaffected.
